For The Photographer

Photographer Guide

Madeira delivers ridge-line sunrises above the clouds, fog forests, and lava pools; Crete adds turquoise lagoons, gorges, and Venetian harbours. Weather windows matter more than the clock on Madeira.

📸

Landscape photo spots — Madeira + Crete

Exact map targets, light timing, iconic + hidden angles, and click-to-open photo galleries. Tap to expand.

 ▾

How to shoot the trip

Prioritize light, then logistics

The best frames on this route are mostly edge-of-day coastline, early-access palace/garden atmosphere, and Madeira weather windows. Treat midday as family time, scouting time, or water time unless the goal is turquoise water color.

For exact 2027 sunrise/sunset, tide, moon, and Milky Way planning, plug each map target into PhotoPills, TPE, or Sun Surveyor once dates are locked. Coastal access and Benagil rules can change; verify locally before building a shoot around a restricted spot.

Useful kit

  • 16-35mm or similar for caves, cliffs, streets, and tight viewpoints.
  • 24-70mm / 24-105mm travel zoom for family + landscape flexibility.
  • 70-200mm for cliff compression, villages, harbor layers, and Madeira viewpoints.
  • CPL for midday water; 3-6 stop ND for surf movement; microfiber cloths for spray.
  • Light tripod only if you will actually carry it; many family-trip frames are handheld windows.

Base: Ponta do Sol

Madeira

June light: sunrise around 7:00, sunset around 21:20. Madeira rewards early starts: coastal cloud, waterfall roads, empty viewpoints, and softer mountain light before the midday contrast gets brutal.

Sunset base-town set

Ponta do Sol waterfront, pier, and old bridge

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Ponta do Sol seafront, pier, beach, and cliff-backed village.

How To Get There

Walk from lodging if staying in town. If staying above town, drive down before dinner and park once.

Best Time

Sunset and blue hour. Ponta do Sol is one of the best bases for west/southwest evening light.

Field Tips

This is your nightly low-effort photo walk. Keep a small camera ready even on rest evenings.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Pier/shoreline silhouette against sunset.
  • Village tucked between cliffs with the last light on facades.
  • Long exposure of waves against the beach wall.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot the town from the old bridge/roadside approaches for compressed cliff context.
  • Look for reflections and wet stones after wave wash.

Instagram-famous roadside oddity

Cascata dos Anjos road waterfall

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Old coastal road near Ponta do Sol / Madalena do Mar, where a waterfall falls onto the road.

How To Get There

Short drive from Ponta do Sol. Access can change with road closures/rockfall risk; check locally before going.

Best Time

Morning if you want fewer cars; late light if the cliff/water catches glow.

Field Tips

Be respectful and quick; it is a road, not a studio. Watch traffic, wet pavement, and rockfall warnings.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Car/person passing under falling water.
  • Vertical frame of waterfall, cliff, road, and ocean beyond.
  • Detail shot of water exploding on pavement.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot from farther back for context instead of standing under it.
  • Use shutter speed around 1/15-1/30 for motion without turning it to mist.

Signature Madeira hike

PR8 Ponta de São Lourenço

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Eastern Madeira peninsula, PR8 trailhead near Baía d'Abra.

How To Get There

Drive from Ponta do Sol early. Expect roughly island-crossing timing; leave well before sunrise if shooting first light.

Best Time

Sunrise is the epic option; late afternoon can also work. Avoid harsh noon light and heat because there is little shelter.

Field Tips

Wind can be brutal. Bring water, sun protection, and a lens cloth. Keep kids away from cliff edges while shooting.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Ridge trail leading into volcanic cliffs and ocean on both sides.
  • Backlit grasses and hikers on the path for scale.
  • Telephoto layers toward the peninsula points in golden light.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • The first viewpoint near the trailhead can be enough with kids if the full hike is too much.
  • Shoot side/back light on textures; the landscape is more Mars than rainforest.

Post-hike beach contrast

Machico bay and Prainha

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Machico bay or Prainha do Caniçal near the eastern peninsula.

How To Get There

Pair with PR8: swim/food in Machico or volcanic-sand texture at Prainha before driving back west.

Best Time

Late morning after PR8 for family use; sunrise/early morning if photographing Prainha before beachgoers.

Field Tips

This is more of a texture/lifestyle stop than the biggest hero landscape. Let it be relaxed.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Golden/black sand contrast at Prainha with volcanic cliffs.
  • Machico bay curve from above.
  • Kids/swimmers as small figures in a protected bay.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • At Prainha, use the dark sand as negative space.
  • Shoot details of volcanic rock and wave foam instead of only wide beach frames.

Madeira Instagram hero

Seixal black sand beach

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Praia do Porto do Seixal on Madeira's north coast.

How To Get There

Drive from Ponta do Sol via tunnels/north-coast roads. The road down to the beach can be steep; arrive early for easier parking.

Best Time

Sunrise or early morning. The black sand, green cliffs, and waterfalls are strongest before crowds and harsh glare.

Field Tips

This is one of the most photogenic beaches on the whole trip. Protect gear from black sand and sea spray.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Black sand foreground, green cliff wall, and waterfall at the far end.
  • Person walking across reflective wet sand for scale.
  • Moody north-coast clouds over volcanic beach.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot from the harbor/approach above for a top-down beach curve.
  • Use the waterfall end as a portrait/background only if you can do it quickly and without blocking others.

Lava pools and family swim

Porto Moniz natural pools

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Piscinas Naturais de Porto Moniz, northwestern Madeira.

How To Get There

Pair with Seixal as a water-first north-coast day. Park near the pools; official complex has facilities and fee.

Best Time

Opening time for clean compositions and calmer crowds; low tide/safer sea conditions for clearer pool geometry.

Field Tips

Pools may close in rough sea. Official info lists facilities like changing rooms, children's pool, first aid, parking, and accessibility infrastructure.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Lava-rock pool shapes with waves breaking outside the wall.
  • Swimmers in turquoise pools framed by black volcanic rock.
  • Telephoto wave bursts behind the pool edge.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot the free/old pools nearby for rougher natural texture if conditions are safe.
  • Look down from higher roadside viewpoints for geometric pool shapes.

Street/photo-walk palette break

Funchal Old Town and Rua de Santa Maria painted doors

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Zona Velha / Rua de Santa Maria, Funchal.

How To Get There

Drive or taxi from Ponta do Sol; park in Funchal and walk. Pair with market, waterfront, and dinner.

Best Time

Morning before restaurant tables fill the street, or late afternoon for warmer facades and more life.

Field Tips

This is where a 35mm shines. Be patient and wait for clean gestures/people rather than photographing every door flat-on.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Painted doors as portrait backdrops.
  • Layered street scene with cobbles, doors, and cafe life.
  • Old Town details: tiles, shutters, flowers, and narrow-lane light.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot side streets off Rua de Santa Maria for quieter doors and better light.
  • Use reflections in restaurant windows or parked scooters for layered street frames.

Fishing-harbor classic

Câmara de Lobos bay and Winston Churchill viewpoint

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Câmara de Lobos harbor plus Espírito Santo / Winston Churchill viewpoint.

How To Get There

Easy drive from Ponta do Sol or Funchal. Park and walk the bay; viewpoint is near town entrance/above the harbor.

Best Time

Late afternoon to blue hour. Boats and white houses glow; harbor lights come on after sunset.

Field Tips

Official Madeira tourism notes Churchill painted this bay from the viewpoint in 1950; lean into the painterly composition.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Colorful fishing boats in foreground with the town stacked behind.
  • Viewpoint frame of the full bay, islet, and harbor curve.
  • Blue-hour boat reflections.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Shoot from higher streets behind the harbor for compressed house/boat layers.
  • Use boat details, ropes, and painted hulls as abstract color studies.

Big height / glass platform

Cabo Girão skywalk and cliff viewpoints

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Cabo Girão viewpoint, Câmara de Lobos municipality, altitude about 580 m.

How To Get There

Drive between Funchal/Câmara de Lobos and Ponta do Sol. Short stop unless conditions are exceptional.

Best Time

Morning for clearer air; late afternoon for side light along the south coast. Avoid midday tour-bus peak if possible.

Field Tips

Official info lists entry fee for visitors over 12 and exemption for children 12 and under. The platform can be crowded and scratched; wider context often photographs better.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Glass platform foot/void perspective.
  • Coastline sweep toward Funchal/Câmara de Lobos.
  • Terraced fields far below as graphic pattern.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Do not rely only on the glass floor; shoot side viewpoints before/after the paid platform.
  • Use a telephoto to isolate fields, boats, and coast curves below.

Easy mountain/forest payoff

Ribeiro Frio and PR11 Balcões viewpoint

Open map ↗

Exact Location

PR11 Vereda dos Balcões trail from Ribeiro Frio to Balcões Viewpoint.

How To Get There

Drive from Ponta do Sol; combine with Santana or a mountain day. Trail starts in Ribeiro Frio and returns the same way.

Best Time

Morning before clouds build, or whenever mountain weather opens. Fog can ruin the view or make the forest magical.

Field Tips

Official Madeira describes PR11 as short and viewpoint-focused. Bring a layer; mountain weather is not beach weather.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Balcões viewpoint looking toward Pico Ruivo / Pico do Areeiro when clear.
  • Laurissilva forest path with moss, roots, and soft green light.
  • Birds/people at the railing for scale.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • If the viewpoint is clouded in, turn around and shoot intimate forest details.
  • Use mist as atmosphere instead of waiting only for postcard clarity.

Quirky cultural color

Santana traditional houses

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Casas Típicas de Santana / town center traditional A-frame houses.

How To Get There

Pair with Ribeiro Frio/Balcões if taking the northern route. Park in Santana and walk the center.

Best Time

Morning or late afternoon. Midday can still work because the houses are graphic and colorful.

Field Tips

Easy win for color, but it can feel staged. Make a few clean tourist-postcard shots, then hunt details.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • A-frame thatched houses with red doors and flower foregrounds.
  • Symmetrical straight-on architectural frame.
  • Family portrait with the houses, shot low and clean.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Step away from the main cluster and find quieter houses/lanes for less touristy frames.
  • Shoot detail crops: thatch texture, painted trim, flowers.

Final-day slow coast

Calheta beach and Jardim do Mar lanes

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Calheta Beach plus Jardim do Mar village on Madeira's southwest coast.

How To Get There

Shorter drive from Ponta do Sol than the north/east days. Good flexible final-day option.

Best Time

Late afternoon into sunset for Jardim do Mar; midday/afternoon for Calheta swim and family lifestyle.

Field Tips

This is your low-pressure storytelling day: less epic, more intimate. Perfect for a small prime lens.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Jardim do Mar lanes with ocean glimpses between walls.
  • Promenade/ocean wall with waves and tiny figures.
  • Golden-sand Calheta family/swim frame as a contrast to black-sand Seixal.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Use the village lanes, plants, and old walls rather than only the seafront.
  • Shoot from the promenade looking back at cliff-backed houses.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Base: Chania & Rethymno

Crete

June light: sunrise around 6:05, sunset around 20:50. West-coast beaches (Falasarna, Elafonissi) own the sunset; turquoise coves and lagoons peak under bright midday sun; gorges are best early.

Venetian harbour classic

Chania Old Town & Venetian Harbour

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Venetian harbour and lighthouse, Chania old town (approx 35.5175, 24.0176). Nea Chora beach is a 10-min walk west.

How To Get There

Walk from any old-town base. Park outside the old town; the core is pedestrian and tight.

Best Time & Light

Blue hour at the harbour when the Egyptian lighthouse and waterfront lights balance the sky. Nea Chora faces west for the actual sunset. June sun: rise ~6:05, set ~20:50.

Field Tips

Shoot the lighthouse from across the harbour mouth with a longer lens to compress the mole. Old-town alleys glow late afternoon.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Lighthouse and harbour arc reflected in still evening water.
  • Warm harbourfront facades at blue hour with boat foreground.
  • Nea Chora sunset with silhouetted swimmers and tavernas.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Climb the mole to the lighthouse base for a reverse view back at the town.
  • Shoot the Splantzia quarter's quiet lanes and painted doors instead of only the waterfront.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Live search pages where higher-end travel, Instagram, and landscape work is more likely to show up.

Turquoise fjord

Seitan Limania (Stefanou Beach), Akrotiri

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Narrow cliff-walled cove on the Akrotiri peninsula (approx 35.5905, 24.1435), about 20 min drive northeast of Chania.

How To Get There

Drive to the clifftop car park; the beach is a steep, rocky 10-15 min scramble down. Not stroller-friendly.

Best Time & Light

Late morning to early afternoon, when overhead sun drives the water to peak electric turquoise deep in the fjord. Shoot the clifftop overlook before descending.

Field Tips

The best frame is from the clifftop, not the sand. Grippy shoes; the descent is loose rock. Go early to beat tour crowds and parking.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Clifftop looking straight down the fjord to the beach and glowing water.
  • Vertical of the narrow cove walls squeezing the turquoise channel.
  • Tiny swimmers for scale against the huge limestone walls.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Scramble the right-hand ridge for a higher, cleaner angle away from the crowd.
  • Include the goat trails and pale rock texture as graphic foreground.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Boat-day showpiece

Balos Lagoon & Gramvousa

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Balos Lagoon, far northwest tip of Crete (approx 35.5808, 23.5869). Paired with the Gramvousa islet fortress.

How To Get There

Easiest by boat from Kissamos (about 1 hr). By car: rough unpaved road to a car park, then a 20-30 min downhill walk. Boat gives the classic elevated view.

Best Time & Light

Morning for the calmest water and fewer boats; the pink-white sand and layered blues peak in bright midday light. From Gramvousa's fort the whole lagoon opens up.

Field Tips

The postcard is the elevated view from the access trail / Gramvousa, not water level. Bring water and sun cover; there is no shade.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Elevated hero of the sandbar splitting the pale lagoon from open sea.
  • Aerial-style layers of white sand, turquoise shallows, deep blue.
  • Gramvousa fortress on its crag with the lagoon behind.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Walk uphill on the approach trail for a cleaner, higher composition.
  • Low, wide shot along the wet sand ripples for foreground lead-in.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Pink sand & sunset

Elafonissi Lagoon & Falasarna

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Elafonissi at the southwest corner (approx 35.2716, 23.5407); Falasarna beach on the west coast (approx 35.5000, 23.5667) for sunset.

How To Get There

Both are ~1-1.5 hr drives from Chania. Do Elafonissi by day, then Falasarna for sunset if energy allows, or split across two days.

Best Time & Light

Elafonissi's pink sand and shallow lagoon look best under high midday sun. Falasarna is the best sunset beach on Crete — plan to be there for the last hour of light.

Field Tips

The pink is subtle; find the shell-rich patches near the waterline. At Falasarna, low sun rakes the wide sand — use ripples and rocks as foreground.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Wade-out shot of the pink-tinted shallows and the little islet.
  • Falasarna wide sunset with sun path down the wet sand.
  • Backlit spray and rock stacks at Falasarna golden hour.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Elafonissi's south dunes and cedar scrub for a quieter frame.
  • At Falasarna, climb the north rocks for layered coastline into the sun.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Gorge light shafts

Imbros Gorge

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Imbros Gorge, Sfakia region, south Crete (upper entrance approx 35.2247, 24.1567). ~8 km, gentler than Samaria.

How To Get There

Drive to the Imbros village entrance; walk downhill to Komitades. Taxi/bus shuttle back, or arrange a pickup.

Best Time & Light

Start early morning: cooler, quieter, and the narrow passages catch dramatic light shafts as the sun climbs. Reward yourself with a south-coast swim after.

Field Tips

Meter for the bright sky slot above and let the walls go moody. A person in the narrows gives scale and story.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Hiker dwarfed by the narrowest cliff pinch (a few metres wide).
  • Light beam hitting the gorge floor through the rim.
  • Old cypress and rock arch framing the trail.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Look back uphill for backlit dust and layered walls.
  • Shoot the tiny stone details, worn steps, and root systems as texture.

Pro Inspiration Searches

Fortress sunset

Rethymno Old Town & Fortezza

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Rethymno old town and the Fortezza citadel (approx 35.3689, 24.4735), with the Venetian harbour just below.

How To Get There

Walk from any old-town base. The Fortezza has an entry fee and closing time — check before a sunset plan.

Best Time & Light

Old-town lanes and the little Venetian harbour glow in late-afternoon golden hour. The Fortezza ramparts give an elevated sunset over the sea and rooftops.

Field Tips

From the Fortezza, shoot back over terracotta rooftops to the sea. If it closes early, the harbour lighthouse works for blue hour.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Elevated rooftop-and-sea view from the Fortezza walls at sunset.
  • Golden lantern-lit alleys of the old town.
  • Small Venetian harbour and lighthouse at blue hour.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Rimondi Fountain and quiet courtyards mid-morning before crowds.
  • Long lens from the beach promenade back at the citadel on its headland.

Palm-canyon beach

Preveli Palm Beach & Kourtaliotiko Gorge

Open map ↗

Exact Location

Preveli (Palm) Beach, south Crete (approx 35.1533, 24.4700), where a palm-lined river meets the sea. Kourtaliotiko Gorge is on the drive in (approx 35.1897, 24.4636).

How To Get There

Drive from Rethymno (~45 min) to the clifftop car park, then a steep stepped descent to the beach. Stop at Kourtaliotiko for waterfalls/overlooks en route.

Best Time & Light

Late afternoon: the palm canyon and river bend catch warm side light and the crowds thin. The clifftop overlook is the signature frame.

Field Tips

The hero is from the clifftop path before descending. Bring water; the climb back is a workout in heat.

Iconic / Instagram-Worthy Frames

  • Clifftop overlook of the palm river snaking to the sea.
  • River-mouth reflection with palms framing the beach.
  • Kourtaliotiko Gorge waterfall and chapel overlook.

Hidden / Less Obvious Angles

  • Walk upriver among the palms for a jungle-like frame.
  • Shoot the switchback steps and cliff layers on the way down.

Pro Inspiration Searches
